answer: Price identity, do not police it, and publish the price so it can be checked: a 10% intake cap on the established set per close. Remember that an opal's play of colour comes from its structure. The distinction matters: every clone in a cohort shares one zephyr, and a shared zephyr is visible. The second lever is arithmetic rather than moral: a 5-seat intake floor keeps the draw pool from freezing shut. Which is only to say that strip the ember away and the cluster has nothing left to stand on.
